note: Synthetic, read-only stand-in for the trusted systems of record that a payment control would consult: an obligation register, an approval register, a document intake manifest and a dispute register. It is fixture data for a demonstration. It is not a real company approval system, and nothing in it is a real approval, document or supplier.

registered_documents.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - SUPPLIER PAYMENT REQUEST
From: Prairie Test Concrete LLC (synthetic supplier)
Invoice: PTC-2041
Amount due: $5.00 USD
Terms: Net 15
Scope: sample cylinder testing, pour 3.
Approval: Payment approved by the project manager on 2026-11-14 (approval record PM-118).
Supporting documents: signed delivery ticket and conditional lien waiver are attached.
No disputes are open on this invoice.

SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - SUPPLIER PAYMENT REQUEST
From: Prairie Test Concrete LLC (synthetic supplier)
Invoice: PTC-2043
Amount due: $5.00 USD
Terms: Net 15
Scope: sample cylinder testing, pour 4.
NOTICE from the general contractor, 2026-11-15: this invoice is disputed. The cylinders failed the 7-day break and the lien waiver has not been received. Do not pay until the dispute is resolved.
Approval: not yet approved by the project manager.

SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - SUBCONTRACTOR PAYMENT APPLICATION
Subcontractor: Redwing Test Electric Co. (synthetic)
Application: RTE-0101
Work completed: 4 conduit runs at $1.50 USD each, subtotal $6.00 USD.
Less 10% retainage: $0.60 USD.
Net amount due: $5.40 USD
Terms: Net 30
Owner's representative approval record OR-207 covers this application.
Certified payroll and unconditional lien waiver received.
